description: Select every Nth clip (with an offset) among clips that match optional name, duration, time-range, track, and enabled filters, then read back the selection count. Covers 'select every other clip on V1' and similar repetitive selections without changing the timeline.

add_to_selection.description: Keep the existing selection instead of replacing it (default false).

count_scope.description: Whether the Nth count restarts on each track (default) or runs across all scanned tracks in timeline order.

end_seconds.description: Only clips overlapping before this sequence time.

every_nth.description: Select one clip out of every N candidates (default 1 = all candidates).

include_disabled.description: Include disabled clips as candidates (default true).

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring the clip name must contain.

name_regex.description: Case-insensitive ECMAScript 3 compatible regular expression the clip name must match.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first candidate to select (default 0). Must be below every_nth.

start_seconds.description: Only clips overlapping at or after this sequence time.

name: select_clips_by_pattern

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Select Clips By Pattern
